source.title: Thirumbi Paar (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
source.source_quality_note: Public commercial music-catalog metadata gives item-level title/artist-credit strings. It supplements the supplied booklet only for authorship metadata and is never used to repair or expand canonical Tamil.

canonical_occurrence_mappings.match_basis: Exact named-song title correspondence after transliteration; the booklet itself prints the Tamil title in scene 31.
Exact named-song title correspondence after transliteration; scene 42 prints `கலப்படம் கலப்படம்` and scene 43 explicitly calls it the `கலப்படம்` song.

mapping_rule: The catalog's other seven tracks are not assigned to the booklet's unnamed singing references merely because they occur in the same film. Only source-named candidates with an exact title match are mapped here.
canonical_text_rule: External track metadata supplies authorship only. Lyrics, wording, spelling and source structure remain controlled exclusively by the verified booklet scan.
